note: Drugs (Stage 2). addictionChanceByTolerance is the wiki's multiplier on a drug's addictiveness (x1 at 0%, x5 at 50%, x15 at 80%). A dose scales the high by 1 - 0.75 x tolerance. seekNeedBelow: an addict goes for a dose when its need is under it. joyBelow: a pawn with recreation under it takes a drug it may take for joy. redoseBelow: not while the high is over this. overdoseHoldOff: no recreational dose while the overdose is over this. searchSeconds: wait this long after finding no drug. Wiki figures: overdose 0.18 to 0.35 a hard dose, 0.5 minor, 0.75 major, 1 fatal, falls 1 a day, major overdose chance 0.5% (here +0.75 severity at once). Binges (ours): the *Days numbers are the mean wait of a pawn addicted to a social (major mood band) or hard (extreme band) drug, or in withdrawal at any mood; a binge lasts bingeHours, takes any drug of its chemical until the high is over bingeRedoseBelow, and ends at a minor overdose or when no drug can be found. Chemical damage (thresholds in Chemicals, wiki): the mean wait between hits is damageMtbDaysAtThreshold at the threshold falling to damageMtbDaysAtFull at full tolerance; a hit takes damageFraction of the organ's hit points for good, never past damageMaxFraction; a major overdose hurts the brain every brainDamageMtbDays on average (wiki 2.5).
